title: 01-login-mobile-en
prompt: Design the LOGIN screen, mobile 390x844. IMPORTANT: this is an UNAUTHENTICATED screen, so it has NO bottom tab bar. Still render the source design's drawn 44px top safe area with a realistic iOS status bar and the drawn 34px bottom home-indicator safe area — content never enters those zones. The page sits on the white #FFFFFF background with 24px horizontal padding. BRAND LOCKUP, centered in the upper third with generous space above: a 56px deep-red #B4232A logo mark, then 'Rosalia's Kitchen' in 22px/600 #1F2937 and 'Staff Hub' in 15px #6B7280 beneath. HEADING: 'Sign in' 24/600 centered with a 14px #6B7280 sub-line 'Welcome back. Use the method your manager set up for you.' across two lines. THE METHOD STACK, all controls full width and at least 52px tall because this is used one-handed: 1) A 52px GOOGLE BUTTON — white with a 1px #E5E7EB border, 12px radius, the Google 'G' mark at the left and 'Continue with Google' in 15px/500 #1F2937, centered. 2) A divider row with a 1px #E5E7EB rule either side of 'or' in 12px #6B7280. 3) An EMAIL field with a 13px/500 #6B7280 label above a 52px input containing 'allison.rodriguez@example.com'. 4) A PASSWORD field labeled 'Password' above a 52px input with masked bullets and a trailing eye icon, with a ghost 'Forgot password?' in 13px #2563EB right-aligned beneath. 5) A full-width 56px primary #2563EB button 'Sign in' with a 12px radius. 6) The unavailable third method: a full-width 52px button at 40 percent opacity with a 1px border, a phone icon, 'Continue with a texted code' and a small gray 'Coming soon' chip — it must read clearly as disabled. Beneath the stack a centered 13px #6B7280 line 'Don't have an account? Ask your manager for an invite.' PINNED ABOVE THE SAFE AREA: a centered EN/ES segmented language toggle with EN active, and a 12px #6B7280 legal line with 'Privacy' and 'Terms' links. Design every label to tolerate about 30 percent text expansion for Spanish — the Google and texted-code button labels are the longest strings and must not clip. Use ONLY the design system's fonts, colors, spacing and components; keep Inter and #2563EB for the primary action. The deep-red #B4232A appears only in the logo mark, never as a button color. No gradients, no serif or decorative typefaces.

title: 03-profile-staff-mobile-en

This is the STAFF view, so it never shows pay rate, employment type, permission overrides or manager-only notes. Sticky header with a back chevron, title 'My profile' 17px/600, and a ghost 'Edit' in #2563EB at the right. PROFILE HEADER, centered: an 88px avatar with a colored-initial fallback 'ML' and a small camera badge overlapping its lower right to signal the photo is changeable; beneath it 'Micah Lozon' at 22px/600, a 13px #6B7280 line 'Employee #1045 · since Mar 2025', and a chip row with an amber 'Server · Level 2' chip and a cyan 'Runner · Level 1' chip. Add a 12px #6B7280 line beneath the chips reading 'Roles and levels are set by your manager.' so the read-only nature is explicit. THE CARD STACK, each a white bordered rounded-xl card with 16px padding and a 15px/600 heading. Card A 'Personal information' with four label-value rows separated by 1px borders, the 12px/500 #6B7280 label above the 14px #1F2937 value — Preferred name 'Micah', Email 'micah.lozon@example.com', Phone '(305) 555-0142', Address '1420 SW 8th St, Miami, FL 33135'. Card B 'Emergency contact' with three rows — Name 'Rosa Lozon', Relationship 'Mother', Phone '(305) 555-0198'. Card C 'Login methods' with three rows, each a provider icon, a name, a 12px #6B7280 detail and a trailing control: 'Google' with 'micah.lozon@example.com' and a teal 'Linked' pill; 'Email & password' with 'Password set Jun 2, 2026' and a ghost 'Change' link; 'Phone OTP' rendered at 45 percent opacity with a gray 'Coming soon' chip. Beneath them a ghost '+ Add a login method' row. Card D 'Language' with a full-width EN/ES segmented toggle, EN active, and a 12px #6B7280 helper 'Changes the app and your notifications.' Card E 'My documents' with four rows, each a document icon, a title, a 12px #6B7280 date line and a trailing status: 'Employee Handbook v4.2' with 'Signed Jul 14, 2026' and a teal check; 'Updated Tip Reporting Policy v2.0' with 'Sent Aug 6, 2026' and an amber 'Signature needed' pill plus a right chevron; 'Food Safety & Allergen Handling v1.8' with 'Signed May 22, 2026' and a teal check; 'W-4 (2026)' with 'Uploaded Mar 4, 2025' and a ghost download icon. Card F 'MY STANDING' — the staff-facing disciplinary ladder widget, and the most sensitive element on this screen, so keep the tone factual and non-punitive. A 15px/600 heading 'My standing' with a 12px #6B7280 sub-line 'Progressive discipline · resets after 12 months without an incident.' Inside, a compact VERTICAL STEPPER with a connecting 2px rail: 'Verbal warning' as a completed node — a filled #6B7280 circle with a white check — with a 12px #6B7280 detail 'May 3, 2026'; a second 'Verbal warning' completed node with 'Jun 12, 2026'; then the CURRENT position as a larger #2563EB filled node on a light #2563EB tinted row with a 2px #2563EB border, labeled 'YOU ARE HERE' in 11px/600 uppercase letter-spaced #2563EB above 'Written warning' in 15px/600 with a 12px #6B7280 'Issued Aug 12, 2026 · signed'; then three upcoming nodes as hollow circles with a 1px #E5E7EB border, their rows at 55 percent opacity and connected by a DASHED rail — 'Write-up', 'Final warning' and 'Suspension', each with a 12px #6B7280 'Next step' or 'Then'. Beneath the stepper a bordered strip with 12px #6B7280 'Your prior actions expire Jun 12, 2027 if there are no further incidents.' Design every label to tolerate about 30 percent text expansion for Spanish. Use ONLY the design system's fonts, colors, spacing and components; keep Inter, #2563EB for the current standing and links, teal #14B8A6 for signed and linked, amber #F59E0B for the signature-needed pill. Never use brand red #B4232A as a button color. No gradients, no serif or decorative typefaces.

title: 27-my-tasks-mobile-en

Under THIS MONTH — 'Refresh allergen binder' with 'Server station · due Aug 31', CHECKED with 'Done Aug 6'. A 12px #6B7280 footer line beneath the list: 'Per-shift tasks reset when your shift ends.' Use ONLY the design system's fonts, colors, spacing and components; keep Inter, teal #14B8A6 for completed and photo-proof, amber #F59E0B for end-of-shift due chips, #2563EB for any link. title: 30a-policy-read-mobile-en
prompt: Design STEP 1 OF THE POLICY SIGNATURE FLOW — reading the document, mobile 390x844, for Micah Lozon. Reuse the source design's mobile shell with the drawn 44px top safe area and iOS status bar and the drawn 34px bottom home-indicator safe area; HIDE the bottom tab bar because this is a focused flow. Sticky header with a back chevron, the title 'Tip Reporting Policy' 17px/600 centered and truncating gracefully, and 'Step 1 of 3' at the right in 12px #6B7280, above a three-segment progress bar with the first segment filled in #2563EB. DOCUMENT META STRIP beneath the header: a bordered rounded-xl row with a document icon, 13px/600 'Updated Tip Reporting Policy' and a 12px #6B7280 line 'Version 2.0 · effective Aug 15, 2026 · 2 min read', plus a small EN/ES segmented toggle at the right with EN active so the reader can switch language. THE DOCUMENT BODY, the bulk of the screen: a scrollable white reading area with comfortable 16px body type, about 1.6 line-height, and 24px between paragraphs. Render realistic policy prose with a clear hierarchy — an 18px/600 section heading '1. Reporting your tips', two body paragraphs explaining that all cash and card tips must be reported at clock-out for every shift and that reported totals are used for payroll tax withholding; an 18px/600 heading '2. Correcting a reported amount' with a paragraph explaining that once a shift is closed only a manager can adjust a reported tip amount and that a written reason is recorded; and an 18px/600 heading '3. Accuracy' with a short bulleted list of three items covering that tip reports are compared against punch records, that repeated discrepancies are reviewed with a manager, and that falsifying a tip report is grounds for disciplinary action. Let the text run beyond the fold so it clearly scrolls, and fade the bottom edge slightly to imply more content. A SCROLL-PROGRESS INDICATOR: a thin 3px #2563EB bar pinned just under the header showing about 60 percent read. PINNED FOOTER above the safe area, on a white surface with a 1px top border: a 12px #6B7280 line with a small info icon reading 'Scroll to the end to continue', then a full-width 56px primary #2563EB button 'I've read this — continue' shown in its ENABLED state. Design every label to tolerate about 30 percent text expansion for Spanish. Use ONLY the design system's fonts, colors, spacing and components; keep Inter — the document body uses the same sans family, never a serif — and #2563EB for the primary action and progress. Never use brand red #B4232A as a button color. No gradients beyond the subtle bottom fade, no decorative typefaces.

title: 30b-signature-canvas-mobile-en

ACKNOWLEDGEMENT BLOCK at the top: a heading 'Sign to acknowledge' 20px/600 #1F2937 and a 13px #6B7280 paragraph 'By signing, you confirm that you have read and understood the Updated Tip Reporting Policy (v2.0, effective Aug 15, 2026).' Draw a realistic handwritten-looking SIGNATURE STROKE across the baseline in dark #1F2937 — a flowing, slightly irregular ink path with natural thick-and-thin variation, reading as a cursive 'M. Lozon', clearly hand-drawn rather than typeset. In the canvas's top-right corner a small 11px #6B7280 label 'Draw your signature'. Design every label to tolerate about 30 percent text expansion for Spanish — the consent sentence is the longest string and must wrap cleanly to three lines without clipping. Use ONLY the design system's fonts, colors, spacing and components; keep Inter for all interface text, with the only handwritten element being the drawn ink signature itself. #2563EB owns the primary action and the checked consent box. Never use brand red #B4232A as a button color. No gradients, no serif or decorative typefaces.
